detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-10-25 A trojaned OVHcloud CLI build was swapped into GitHub releases, and a quick version check was enough to spot it. If you pull release binaries straight from GitHub into your infra, verify checksums or signatures. Trust, but verify. 🔗 https://www. stepsecurity.io/blog/ovhcloud- cli-github-release-swap-glassworm # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
